info.name: geneav — Scan API
info.description:
Document malware scanning.

Set the `baseUrl` variable to https://geneav.com for production, or http://localhost:8080 when running the local docker stack.

Interactive docs: https://geneav.com/docs

variable.description: API origin. Use http://localhost:8080 against the local stack.
A gav_live_... key from the dashboard. Only needed for the metered request.

request.description:
Uploads one document and returns a clean/infected verdict.

The `file` form field MUST have its type set to File. Do not add a Content-Type header by hand — Postman generates the multipart boundary, and overriding it drops the boundary and breaks the request.

Limits: 25 MB per file. Anonymous requests are rate limited to 10/min per IP.

Responses: 200 completed, 400 missing/empty file, 413 too large, 415 unsupported type, 429 rate limited, 503 scan engine down.

Same endpoint, authenticated with an API key so the scan counts against the account's monthly plan quota.

Usage is recorded only after a scan succeeds — failed scans are not billed. Returns 402 once the quota is exhausted (free plan = 100 scans/month).
Reports whether the API and the ClamAV engine are ready. Returns status UP, or DEGRADED when the engine is unreachable.
